statement: grade this address by what settled on chain; I claim nothing else.
how_to_enter.sign: EIP-191 personal_sign over the statement's exact bytes (six LF-terminated lines, UTF-8, no byte order mark) with the address's own key
how_to_enter.send: the statement and the 0x signature, by any channel, to the operator; the check is `python -m rights_events.arena_door enrol`, offline, and anyone can run it
how_to_enter.then: the address is graded from the first capture after its entry; until then it reads LISTED, NOT YET CAPTURED
how_to_enter.leave: the same six lines with the withdrawal heading and last line, signed by the same key; rows already pinned stand

board_under_r195.what: the cohort's FULL board rows read by R195's words; not rows of the door: none of these addresses enrolled
the cohort's FULL board rows read by R195's words; not rows of the door: none of these addresses enrolled

kill_line.line: OPEN 0 of 20: 0 outside entrants, 0 of 3 outside FULL rows over a complete window

rules.R191: an address enters by its own signed statement; the proof is the arithmetic, not anyone's word
rules.R193: SETTLED.md's figures as the arena's row carries them, beside round trips per coin opened and closed inside the window; carried-in and open positions counted, never valued
rules.R194: a trade id on the pinned pages of two addresses of one capture is a crossing: disclosed, never by itself a finding
rules.R195: KEEP = complete window, FULL, >= 1 closed trip, net with funding > 0, trip net > 0, trip net uncrossed > 0; DROP = every other complete FULL row and NONE; UNDECIDED = PARTIAL or REFUSED; OPEN = window not complete
rules.R196: A settled net, not a finding about skill; the page does not name counterparties; the label is self-declared.
rules.R198: a shot is one ask delivered, entered only by the operator's quoted word; CLOSED at 20 asks with 0 outside entrants; CLEARED at 3 outside FULL rows over a complete window

what_is_not_claimed: No badge, no rank on the venue, no return, no price, no finding about anyone's skill or about who trades from an address. A door, a grader and the files they read.
